description: ProfileID is a trusted digital career profile powered by GenuineIN. It connects verified education, skills, competencies, experience, credentials, projects, certifications, and career evidence into one intelligent profile. Through ChatGPT, users can securely access and use their ProfileID data for career guidance, skill-gap analysis, job readiness, resume and portfolio creation, opportunity matching, and personalized career recommendations.

defaultPrompt: Analyze my ProfileID and tell me my key strengths, skills, and career potential.
Review my ProfileID and identify my skill gaps and the top actions to improve my job readiness.
Based on my ProfileID, suggest the best career paths and opportunities that match my skills and experience.
